spec: §15 suite H (reproducibility); §11 obligations: the schedule must be reproducible from the request plus scheduler version; §9.2 schedule_hash = SHA-256 of the schedule's JCS bytes
derivation: Submit the identical canonical request twice to the same scheduler version. §11 requires reproducibility, so the resulting schedule bytes must match and §9.2 then gives equal schedule hashes. This does not demand that a consumer check a schedule_hash inside schedule.bindings: the §11 schema has no such field.
